whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm tox.ini no longer carries a `testenv.deps` list in which no requirement is pinned with `==`.
